Bill.BriefDescription: Designating the International Peace Arch the official state peace monument.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to designating the official state peace monument;and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The international peace arch is hereby designated as the officialpeace monument of the state of Washington.
